Name: Token Renewal Job
Author: admin

Parameters.Description: Specify the integration environments job should update the refresh tokens for. Parameter accepts multiple values as a comma separated string, individual values should be enclosed in double-quotes ("").
Specify the connector names job should update the refresh tokens for. Parameter accepts multiple values as a comma separated string, individual values should be enclosed in double-quotes ("").

Description: Token renewal job should be used to periodically update the refresh token configured for the integration. By default, the refresh token expires every 90 days, making integration unusable upon expiration. It is recommended to run this job every 7 or 14 days to make sure that refresh token will be up to date.
